shared_rules: Token predicate sees each actual post-entry event, including a token source itself, creature and noncreature tokens, with controller filtering provided by FilteredEntersYou. Batch consumers remain one-per-batch.

Existing IfThisAbilityResolutionNumber watcher records actual resolution for exact source incarnation/definition/ability origin. Countered packet consumes no ordinal; additional triggered instances each resolve separately; rows reset each turn.

Noncreature ordinal is actual caster total casts minus actual caster creature casts. Actual selected stack face is already classified centrally before observers. Filter requires noncreature face and contextual count; outer SpellCast.ordinal remainsNone because its legacy ordinal counts all spells. No new history counter.
